title: confiture test-db list --format json
description: Every confiture-managed template and clone on the server: each database whose COMMENT carries confiture's template or clone marker, whichever project provisioned it. Assembled by the command from ManagedDatabase.to_dict. An empty list means no managed database, not a failure.

databases.description: The managed databases, in pg_database order.

detail.description: For a template, the db/ content hash it was built from; for a clone, the name of the template it was cloned from.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
